newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean president to visit Japan next month.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean president to visit Japan next month.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam will visit Japan on January 25-26 for talks with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, Kim's spokesman said on Tuesday.
Their talks will be held in the Japanese resort of Beppu on Kyushu island to make Kim's visit "free of formalities" and allow them to "exchange frank opinions", he said.

The January meeting will follow Hashimoto's visit to the South Korean resort island of Cheju last June, when they agreed to cooperate on co-hosting the 2002 World Cup soccer games and dealing with North Korea.
Japan and South Korea agreed to let Japan host the final and South Korea the opening game.

Japan has backed a joint proposal by Seoul and Washington for four-nation peace talks with North Korea and China aimed at replacing the 1953 armistice agreement that ended the three-year Korean War with a peace treaty.
